verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state stablecoin/crypto payments settle as fiat in the Stripe balance in local currency, with refunds supported, directly matching the finance-lead requirement to never hold crypto on the books; this is distinct from optional Treasury/stablecoin-balance features which remain opt-in for those who want to hold stablecoins. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of fiat settlement behavior in production (community threads discuss payout mechanics/fees but don't directly corroborate the auto-fiat-settlement claim).
